_note: Pre-duel lead-ins (AdventureLeadIns). Edit freely. Every spoken line is "Speaker: text", where Speaker is a short name from `names`. A scene is {narration, lines}. `pairs` is main character -> opponent character -> slot. Slots, in the order they are tried: boss_again (a boss node, and the main lost the last duel against them), boss (any boss node), after_loss (lost the last duel against them), level (met before, and the main's personality level at least level_min), act3 (met before, in act 3), again (met before), first (never met). A slot can be a list of variants; the first whose conditions hold is used. Variant conditions: deck (the opponent's deck family), main_deck (the main's deck family), met (true: met before, false: never met). Unconditioned Mourne lines are the unmarked Mercenary Lord; toll-gate lines are variants keyed to shade_mind_siege. A lead-in already shown this run is skipped when a later slot fits. With no pair entry, the opponent's `calls` entry plays (a call can be a list of variants with the same conditions) and the main answers with a `replies` line whose fits holds the call's kind or "any".

first.narration: Dame Alder Rooke, Edric's wife, has caught up with him. He left for the Heart without telling her.
lines: Alder: Edric Rooke! You went after the Heart without one word to me!
Edric: I left a note!
Alder: For Wren! Shield up, you coward!

again.narration: Alder has brought the whole coven out to watch her take her husband home.
lines: Alder: The whole coven's watching, Edric! Don't you dare go easy!
Edric: Yes, dear.

after_loss.narration: Alder put Edric on his back last time, in front of the whole coven.
lines: Edric: My ribs still remember last time, Alder.
Alder: Good! Then they'll know to duck!

act3.narration: With the Heart a day's walk away, Alder makes her last try at taking Edric home.
lines: Alder: Come home, Edric! Let Quarr keep the cursed thing!
Edric: Quarr can't hold it alone, Alder.
Alder: Neither can you! Raise that shield!

level.narration: Edric has started fighting like his brother Torvan Hask, and Alder has noticed.
lines: Alder: You fight like a Hask now! Is that Torvan's doing?
Edric: I haven't seen Torvan in years!
Alder: Then why is he writing to you?!

first.narration: Emrys Rooke, Edric's eldest son, wants a fight to prove himself to his father.
lines: Emrys: Father! Caedan says you drop your left shoulder!
Edric: Does he, now?

again.narration: The grey metal on Emrys's arms has spread since Edric last saw him.
lines: Emrys: Look, Father! It's growing!
Edric: So I see. Does your mother know?

after_loss.narration: Emrys has a win over his father now, and he is trying very hard not to gloat.
lines: Edric: Go on, son. Say it.
Emrys: I BEAT YOU! ...Sorry, Father.

boss.narration: Emrys Rooke, Edric's eldest son, blocks the crossing. Win or lose, he means to come along.
lines: Emrys: Father! Get past me, and I'm coming with you!
Edric: Your mother will skin us both.
Emrys: Then she can skin me on the road!

boss_again.narration: Emrys sent his father home from the crossing last time. He's waiting there now.
lines: Emrys: I beat you, Father! You can't go alone!
Edric: Once, Emrys. Don't get used to it.

first.narration: Caedan Vale fought beside Edric in the war and taught him the sword. Caedan's son lives with Edric.
lines: Caedan: Rooke. How's my boy?
Edric: Taller than me. Tavin misses you, Caedan.
Caedan: ...Guard.

again.narration: Caedan is teaching Edric's son Emrys the Vale sword, as he promised when the boy was born.
lines: Caedan: Your boy drops the same shoulder. I'm fixing it.
Edric: Emrys? You're still teaching him?
Caedan: I promised. Guard.

after_loss.narration: Caedan's last win over Edric came from the same old fault.
lines: Caedan: Left shoulder! Still!
Edric: You've been saying that since the war!

boss.narration: Caedan Vale taught Edric the sword in the war. Now he blocks the road to see what Edric made of it.
lines: Caedan: Rooke. How's my boy?
Edric: Taller than me. Tavin misses you, Caedan.
Caedan: ...Guard.

boss.narration: Caedan blocks the road to the Heart. He wants to see what his old student has become.
lines: Caedan: I taught you outside the blood, Rooke. Show me 'twas worth it.
Edric: Guard, Caedan!

boss_again.narration: Edric fell to Caedan on this road last time. Now Caedan has a fresh burn on his arm.
lines: Edric: Caedan! Who did that to your arm?
Caedan: Something burning came through ahead of you. ...Guard, Rooke.

first.narration: Gideon Mourne lost his title and his lands. He's raising a company now, and he hates knights who kneel.
lines: Mourne: Well, well! Sir Kneels-a-Lot!
Edric: That's Sir Edric to you, Mourne.
Mourne: And that's LORD Mourne to you!

again.narration: Mourne is after the Heart like everyone else, and already looking for a buyer.
lines: Mourne: Rooke! What's the Vigil bidding for the Heart? Coin or land, I'm not fussy!
Edric: Nothing. It isn't yours to sell.
Mourne: Not YET!

after_loss.narration: Mourne won their last duel and has bragged about it since.
lines: Edric: You've told every inn on this road, Mourne. I heard you in three.
Mourne: Four! Now draw!

level.narration: Mourne offers Edric a share of the Heart if he helps take it off Quarr.
lines: Mourne: Help me take it off Quarr, Rooke, and half is yours!
Edric: I don't want half! I want it locked away.
Mourne: Locked away? Who holds the key, Rooke? A KING?

act3.narration: Mourne has a buyer for the Heart lined up, and only Edric in his way.
lines: Mourne: Out of my road, Sir Kneels-a-Lot! I've a buyer waiting!
Edric: Then he'll wait a long time, Mourne.

first.narration: Bram Ashmark is burning his way toward the Heart. Edric has come to stop him.
lines: Edric: Stop this, Bram! Those were people's homes!
Ashmark: ...They were warm.

again.narration: Ashmark is thinner and hungrier than when Edric last stood in his way.
lines: Edric: Bram! You were someone's son once!
Ashmark: ...Whose?

after_loss.narration: Edric lost to Ashmark last time. Ashmark walked off still hungry.
lines: Edric: Nothing fills you, does it?
Ashmark: You might.

act3.narration: Ashmark has nearly reached the Heart. He wants what waits behind the gates.
lines: Ashmark: The gold one... behind the wall... I can smell it!
Edric: Then I'll stand in front of the wall, Bram.

level.narration: Edric has been asking about Ashmark in the villages he burned.
lines: Edric: There was a boy who sang on the old road, Bram. Was that you?
Ashmark: SHUT UP!

boss.narration: Halden Quarr wears the Lodestone Heart and guards it from everyone. Edric wants it locked in a vault.
lines: Edric: Give me the Heart, Quarr! It belongs in a vault!
Quarr: Vaults get opened, Rooke. Go home.

boss.narration: Halden Quarr still wears the Heart. Edric has come to take it from him.
lines: Edric: That thing could open every gate there is, Quarr.
Quarr: Aye. And I'll never use it. Go home.

boss_again.narration: Quarr sent Edric home from the Heart last time. Edric has come back for it.
lines: Edric: You can't carry it forever, Quarr!
Quarr: Go home, Rooke.

first.narration: Halden Quarr carries the Lodestone Heart, far from his post. Edric wants it in a vault.
lines: Edric: Quarr?! Out here?
Quarr: Move.

first.narration: Marrow is a construct built from scrap. Some of her once marched in Mourne's old company.
lines: Marrow: My lord! Some of me marched under your crest!
Mourne: Then salute me, scrap heap.
Marrow: The rest of me wants to bite!

again.narration: Marrow has a name stamped under her jaw, and she can't read it.
lines: Marrow: My lord... whose name is under my jaw?
Mourne: How should I know?
Marrow: Some of me thinks you do.

after_loss.narration: Marrow's crew watched her beat Mourne last time.
lines: Mourne: Lost to a scrap heap. Nobody hears of this.
Marrow: Some of me already told Kell.

boss.narration: Marrow is a construct built from scrap. Some of her once marched in Mourne's old company.
lines: Marrow: My lord! Some of me marched under your crest!
Mourne: Then salute me, scrap heap.
Marrow: The rest of me wants to bite!

boss.narration: Marrow blocks the salvage road. If Mourne wins, part of his old company comes back to him.
lines: Marrow: Beat me, and some of me will follow you again!
Mourne: Only SOME?!

boss_again.narration: Mourne lost to Marrow on the salvage road last time. She's wearing a piece of his armour.
lines: Mourne: Give that back, you walking junk pile!
Marrow: No. It fits, my lord.

first.narration: Sable Draik, captain of the Draik Company, wants Mourne in her crew.
lines: Sable: Gideon Mourne! Just the man I wanted!
Mourne: That's LORD Mourne to you, pirate!

again.narration: Sable has brought a company coat in Mourne's size.
lines: Sable: Try it on, Gideon! Just once!
Mourne: I'm raising my OWN company, pirate!

after_loss.narration: Mourne lost to Sable last time. Now she wants him more than ever.
lines: Mourne: Why me, Sable?!
Sable: You lost and still called me pirate! I like that!

boss.narration: Sable's last offer: join the Draik Company, or be her partner in the Heart.
lines: Sable: Last chance, Gideon! The coat, or half the Heart!
Mourne: LORD Mourne!
Sable: Not on my ship, darling!

boss.narration: Sable Draik, captain of the Draik Company, has heard of a lord with no lands. She wants him.
lines: Sable: You! The lord with no lands! Win, and you're crew!
Mourne: And if I lose?!
Sable: Cargo!

boss_again.narration: Sable won their last meeting. The company coat is still over her arm.
lines: Sable: It's still your size, Gideon!
Mourne: Put that thing away.

first.narration: Sir Edric Rooke kneels to the Vigil. Mourne would rather stay titleless than kneel to anyone.
lines: Mourne: Sir Kneels-a-Lot! What a treat!
Edric: Mourne. You're a long way from your hall.
Mourne: LORD Mourne, you old dog!

again.narration: Edric has fire in his hands now. Mourne wants to know who he paid for it.
lines: Mourne: Who's holding your leash, Rooke?!
Edric: Nobody! It's mine!
Mourne: Hah! Everyone says that!

again.narration: Mourne wants to know what a knight serves once his king is gone.
lines: Mourne: Both kings lie dead, Rooke! Whom do you kneel to now?!
Edric: The ones who can't fight back, Mourne.

after_loss.narration: Mourne lost to Edric last time and wants the rematch now.
lines: Mourne: You beat me on your knees, Rooke! Get up and do it again!
Edric: As you like. LORD Mourne.
Mourne: Don't you DARE be polite to me!

level.narration: Mourne carries a demon's mark now, and Edric wants to know what it cost him.
lines: Edric: They say you sleep well these days, Mourne.
Mourne: Like a lord! Jealous, Rooke?

level.narration: Mourne has a small hired company behind him now, and Edric has noticed.
lines: Edric: You've got men behind you now, Mourne.
Mourne: A company! MINE! And not one of them kneels!

act3.narration: Mourne is hiring swords for a company of his own. He'd like the realm's best one.
lines: Mourne: Rooke! Still guarding villages for free?
Edric: Somebody should.
Mourne: Work for me, and somebody will PAY you!

first.narration: Mourne and Ashmark both carry a demon's mark from the same toll gate.
lines: Mourne: So you've got his mark too, boy!
Ashmark: Hungry...
Mourne: Yes, yes, I can see that!

first.narration: Bram Ashmark is burning his way to the Heart. Mourne has seen the brand on his arm.
lines: Mourne: That brand, boy! Who gave you that?
Ashmark: A man... at a gate...
Mourne: Keep it! I've troubles enough!

again.narration: Both of them paid the man at the toll gate. Mourne wants to compare prices.
lines: Mourne: I traded him a claim. What did you trade, boy?
Ashmark: ...Everything.

again.narration: Mourne is raising a hired company, and he wants Ashmark's fire in it.
lines: Mourne: Fight for me! I pay in coin!
Ashmark: Coin is cold.

after_loss.narration: Ashmark won their last fight. Mourne thinks he can hire him anyway.
lines: Mourne: Work for me. I'll point, you eat.
Ashmark: I'll eat you.

act3.narration: Mourne wants the Heart to sell. Ashmark wants what is behind it.
lines: Mourne: Leave something for me to sell.
Ashmark: Bones. Sell the bones.

level.narration: Mourne wonders what the man at the toll gate asked Ashmark.
lines: Mourne: What did he ask you first, at the gate? He asked me my name!
Ashmark: ...What I wanted.
Mourne: And you told him?! Fool!

level.narration: Mourne's company has grown, and he wants Ashmark in its front rank.
lines: Mourne: Front rank! First pick of the spoils!
Ashmark: I'd eat the front rank.

boss.narration: Halden Quarr wears the Lodestone Heart and guards it. Mourne has sold everything else he had.
lines: Mourne: Everything's for sale, Quarr! I traded my claim at the toll gate!
Quarr: And look at you.
Mourne: LOOK at me? I'm doing splendidly!

boss.narration: Halden Quarr wears the Lodestone Heart and guards it. Mourne wants to buy it, or take it.
lines: Mourne: Name your price, Quarr! Everyone has one!
Quarr: Not for sale, lad.

boss.narration: Quarr has turned down every buyer on the road. Mourne has brought a better offer.
lines: Mourne: You were Pact once, Quarr. Sell like one.
Quarr: Was.

boss_again.narration: Mourne has come back to Quarr with a bigger purse.
lines: Mourne: Half of what it's worth. Final offer.
Quarr: Naught for sale. Go home.

first.narration: Halden Quarr carries the Lodestone Heart, far from his post. Mourne knows what it would sell for.
lines: Mourne: You look tired, Quarr! Let me carry it!
Quarr: Keep walking.

first.narration: Siphon, a runaway construct, drinks from the leylines. Ashmark burns the same ones.
lines: Siphon: You are burning my leyline!
Ashmark: Then take it back.

again.narration: Siphon has been rebuilt with new wards. It is still hungry.
lines: Siphon: New wards. They itch. You have charge?
Ashmark: No.
Siphon: Liar. You are warm!

again.narration: Siphon stands on a leyline Ashmark has already drained.
lines: Siphon: This one was mine! You left only ash!
Ashmark: More...

after_loss.narration: Siphon won last time, and drank some of Ashmark's fire.
lines: Siphon: You were delicious. Thank you.
Ashmark: Give it BACK!

boss.narration: Siphon has drained three leylines since it escaped the Collegium. It wants Ashmark's fire next.
lines: Siphon: So much charge in you! Give it to me!
Ashmark: Mine!

boss_again.narration: Siphon drank its fill from Ashmark last time. It is starving again.
lines: Siphon: Give! GIVE IT!
Ashmark: ...Me too.

first.narration: Sir Edric Rooke stands between Ashmark and the next town.
lines: Edric: Turn back, Bram!
Ashmark: To what?

again.narration: Edric has followed Ashmark's smoke to the next town.
lines: Edric: There's still a man in there, Bram! I know it!
Ashmark: Look closer.

after_loss.narration: Ashmark lost to Edric last time and has come back hungrier.
lines: Ashmark: Again!
Edric: Again? You can barely stand, Bram!

boss.narration: Edric has found a fire of his own. Ashmark can smell it on him.
lines: Ashmark: You burn now, hero!
Edric: Not like you!
Ashmark: Not yet...

boss.narration: Edric's coven has put out every fire Ashmark lit on the way here.
lines: Ashmark: Water... you put out my fires.
Edric: Every one, Bram.

boss_again.narration: The fire has spread up Edric's arms since he last beat Ashmark.
lines: Ashmark: Does it want more yet, hero?
Edric: ...Every day.

boss_again.narration: Edric put Ashmark down on this road before.
lines: Ashmark: Put me down again, hero. Try.
Edric: Stay down this time, Bram.

first.narration: Gideon Mourne carries a mark from the same toll gate as Ashmark.
lines: Mourne: Same mark, boy! Mine's just better behaved!
Ashmark: Yours is quiet.

first.narration: Gideon Mourne lost his lands and is raising a hired company. Ashmark is on his road.
lines: Mourne: Out of my road, boy! I've a company to raise!
Ashmark: Men... warm ones.

again.narration: Mourne wants Ashmark in his hired company, and he's willing to pay.
lines: Mourne: Join my company. I know every road.
Ashmark: Fuel.

after_loss.narration: Mourne won their last fight and thinks he can keep Ashmark on a leash.
lines: Mourne: Heel, boy!
Ashmark: ...I remember you.

level.narration: Mourne has a deal: the Heart for him, and whatever is behind the wall for Ashmark.
lines: Mourne: Give me the Heart, and you can eat whatever's behind the wall!
Ashmark: You first.

boss.narration: Halden Quarr wears the Lodestone Heart and guards it. Ashmark wants the Eidolons behind the gates, to eat.
lines: Quarr: It won't make you more, lad. Go home.
Ashmark: Home...?

boss.narration: Halden Quarr still wears the Heart, and Ashmark has found him again.
lines: Quarr: Go home, lad.
Ashmark: ...What home?

boss_again.narration: Quarr turned Ashmark back from the Heart last time.
lines: Ashmark: The pale one... the moths... she's hungry too...
Quarr: Then she'll eat you first.

first.narration: Halden Quarr carries the Lodestone Heart, far from his post. Ashmark wants the gates it opens.
lines: Ashmark: I smell it on you!
Quarr: Walk away, lad.

_joined_note: A personality that joined the run deck (Emrys for Edric, Kell for Mourne) adds one line after the exchange, at most once per act. Keys: `once` (the first duel after joining), an opponent character, `construct` (an opponent tagged construct), then `any`.

Emrys Rooke.Caedan Vale: Emrys: Master Vale! Watch my shoulder this time!
Emrys Rooke.Osric Thornwald: Emrys: Master Osric! I've kept up my reading!
Emrys Rooke.Gideon Mourne: Emrys: Is that the lord Mother warned me about?
Emrys Rooke.Bram Ashmark: Emrys: Father... he's looking at me like I'm food!
Emrys Rooke.construct: Emrys: Does it feel it when you hit it?
Emrys Rooke.any: Emrys: Can I take this one, Father? ...No? Fine.

Orvath Kell.once: Kell: Gorget's polished, my lord. Where do we march?
Orvath Kell.Marrow: Kell: Those rivets... those were ours!
Orvath Kell.Osric Thornwald: Kell: Grove blood, my lord. Same as mine.
Orvath Kell.Sable Draik: Kell: Draiks. Count your purse after, my lord.

_whispers_note: Ashmark takes something from each person he beats. In later lead-ins that run, one of them can speak as a third line: `from` is keyed by the beaten character, `own` plays when no beaten voice is left. Each whisper plays once a run. `answer` sometimes follows.

from.Siphon: The leash was warm... why did we break it...
from.Gideon Mourne: Nobody left to pay me... nobody...
from.Sable Draik: It was his size... his size...
from.Caedan Vale: How tall is he now... how tall...
from.Emrys Rooke: Father will come. He always comes.

own: So many carts in the yard... all waiting...
Mother left bread by the fire...
You could stop. You could just... stop.

Sable Draik.narration: Sable Draik captains the Draik Company, hexers who deal in stolen mana. She can see yours.
Sable Draik.line: Sable: That's a lot of mana for one traveller! Hand it over, darling!

Sable Draik.narration: Sable Draik has another contract, and this time your name is on it.
Sable Draik.line: Sable: Nothing personal, darling! You're on a contract!

Sable Draik.narration: Sable Draik's crew has the road blocked. She says it's a toll.
Sable Draik.line: Sable: The crew voted, darling. You're paying the toll!

Osric Thornwald.narration: Osric Thornwald, an old druid of the grove, sits reading in the middle of the road.
Osric Thornwald.line: Osric: Hm? Did the grove send you?

Osric Thornwald.narration: Osric Thornwald has moved his reading a little further down the road.
Osric Thornwald.line: Osric: Ah! Back for another lesson, are we?

Osric Thornwald.narration: Osric Thornwald is tending a sapling in the road and does not look up.
Osric Thornwald.line: Osric: Mind your feet. I've regrown that one twice.

Siphon.narration: Siphon, a runaway construct, is starving. It can smell the mana on you.
Siphon.line: Siphon: You have charge! Give it!

Siphon.narration: Siphon remembers the taste of your mana, and it is starving again.
Siphon.line: Siphon: You came back! You are so full of charge!

Siphon.narration: Siphon has been fed since you last met, and it is being polite about it.
Siphon.line: Siphon: Good evening. May I have your charge? Please?

Marrow.narration: Marrow, a construct built out of scrap, is always looking for parts.
Marrow.line: Marrow: Good joints! Some of me wants them!

Marrow.narration: Marrow has new plates since you last met, and she still wants your joints.
Marrow.line: Marrow: Some of me remembers you! The hungry part!

Marrow.narration: Marrow is still looking for the name stamped under her jaw.
Marrow.line: Marrow: You! Can you read? What does my jaw say?

Dame Alder Rooke.narration: Dame Alder Rooke, matriarch of the coven, guards the roads her family travels.
Dame Alder Rooke.line: Alder: Turn back! My family's on this road!

Dame Alder Rooke.narration: Dame Alder Rooke has her coven out on the road, watching for strangers.
Dame Alder Rooke.line: Alder: You again! I warned you once!

Dame Alder Rooke.narration: Dame Alder Rooke has heard you've been on her family's road again.
Dame Alder Rooke.line: Alder: Twice on my family's road?! Shield up, stranger!

Emrys Rooke.narration: Emrys Rooke, Sir Edric's eldest son, wants practice against strangers.
Emrys Rooke has been practising since you last met.
Emrys Rooke.line: Emrys: You again! Good! I've been practising!

Emrys Rooke.narration: Emrys Rooke is looking for his father, and he hopes you've seen him.
Emrys Rooke.line: Emrys: Have you seen my father? Grey mail, plain sword?

Caedan Vale.narration: Caedan Vale, the last Vale swordsman, is blocking the road.
Caedan Vale is blocking the road, sword already drawn.

_replies_note: fits: the call kinds a reply answers (challenge, demand, warning, question, ask, any). `question` asks who you are; `ask` asks you for help. `construct`: only against a construct. level_min: the main's personality level needed; a reply that has one is preferred once it is reached. A reply can also hold the variant conditions met, deck and main_deck.

Sir Edric Rooke.line: Edric: I'd feed you if I could...
Edric: You'll get nothing from me.
Edric: Edric Rooke. Just passing through.
Edric: Nobody sent me. I'm bound for the Heart.
Edric: Sorry, friend. I can't help you.
Edric: I wish I could tell you.
Edric: Caedan taught me the sword. Shall I show you?
Edric: I've stood against worse than you this year.

Gideon Mourne.line: Mourne: Do you know who you're talking to?!
Mourne: I don't pay. I get paid!
Mourne: Take it off me, then!
Mourne: Kings have warned me. Look where they are now!
Mourne: Warn me again, and I'll bill you for it!
Mourne: Who's asking? Never mind. Draw!
Mourne: What's it worth to you?
Mourne: Do I look like a guide?
Mourne: I'm hiring, you know! Win, and I'll make you an offer!
Mourne: I've paid worse tolls than you!
Mourne: I had a whole company once. You'd never have made the front rank.

Bram Ashmark.line: Ashmark: Ask the ones I ate.
